intro: Arugal's Folly is a Forsaken quest in Silverpine Forest where Dalar Dawnweaver investigates the true origin of the worgen prowling near the Greymane Wall. By analyzing harvested worgen remains, Dalar seeks to prove that Archmage Arugal was an imposter who merely bound the creatures rather than conjured their curse.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.
These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.
Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is.
These pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt.
Regrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.
